data.overview: Build a reliable workflow that reconciles daily inventory and order exports, surfaces material variances and gives operations leaders a short decision-ready report.

data.next_step: Send the concise proposal and ask for two representative exports for discovery.

data.opening_angle: Lead with a controlled, exception-first reconciliation workflow.

data.full_text:
Hello Example Retail Cooperative,

Your brief stood out because the goal is not simply to move data between exports—it is to give operations a dependable way to spot and resolve the variances that matter.

I would begin with a short discovery sprint using representative inventory and order exports. Together we would define the matching rules, tolerance thresholds and exception categories, then build a controlled reconciliation workflow with a traceable audit trail. The first delivery would include a concise weekly variance report so managers can focus on decisions instead of raw data.

Before committing to any platform-specific integration, I would validate the available exports and acceptance rules with your team. That keeps the scope grounded and gives you a useful prototype quickly.

Regards,
Demo Consultant
